title: Modern Retractable Wall Hook, 2-1/2-Inch Extension | Mediterranean Blue | Retractable Hooks And Garment Rods | Allied Brass
body_html:
Need a place to hang a robe or towel in the bathroom—without hardware sticking out into a tight space? This modern retractable wall hook extends for use, then pushes back in so it stays out of the way in Mediterranean Blue, which presents a deep, sophisticated blue with subtle purple undertones, evoking the rich depths of coastal waters for a bold yet refined statement.

  • Mediterranean Blue transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Built for everyday use — rated to hold up to 15 pounds.
  • Coordinate your space — part of the Retractable Hooks and Garment Rods collection for cohesive transitional bathroom hardware.
  • Personalize the detail — remove the supplied knob tip and replace it with a cabinet knob of your own.

Specs & Installation

  • Hanging extension: 2-1/2 inches
  • Product dimensions (L x H x W): 2 x 2 x 3.75 inches
  • Weight capacity: up to 15 lb
  • Fits standard interior walls
  • Installation requires drilling one 3/4-inch diameter hole through drywall plus three small holes
  • All mounting hardware included (toggle bolts included)

_previous.description: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. The hook installs quickly and easily without the need for additional support on or built into the wall — just drill a hole and use the included toggle bolts to fasten it in place. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2'' of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your decor. Gives you the option to remove the knob tip supplied with the item and replace it with a cabinet knob of your own, allowing you to match existing ones in the room!
